messages:
maya: Heads-up — raptor-20b (onboarded yesterday) started showing a verbosity spike after the q4_0 canary rollout. Short prompts are getting long, repetitive tails. Also seeing p95/p99 latency drift on canary buckets. Anyone on call?

deploy-bot: Rollout 2026-03-15T10:12:00Z -> canary group 'raptor-canary-3' (instances: g4dn-xlarge)

eval-bot: Regression alert: \"raptor-20b@q4_0\" — eval-suite: general_qa. Metric deltas vs baseline: perplexity +11.7%, hallucination_rate +7.9%, avg_tokens_per_response +42%

nate: repro snippet I used: short prompt 'What time is it?' -> response adds long explanation and unrelated suggestions. Also saw repeated \'(as a reminder)\' phrases.

simon: Could be kv-cache warmup + quantized KV interplay. Quick test: flip kv_cache off and run same sample. If repetition goes away, kv mmap or rewind bug.

carol: I started a microbench job (job id: mb-271305) comparing kv_cache=true vs false, and fused_attn_v2 vs fused_attn_v1 kernels. ETA ~20m.

maya: Deployment config excerpt (canary):
```json
{
  "model": "raptor-20b",
  "variant": "q4_0",
  "batching": { "max_tokens": 2048, "batch_window_ms": 8 },
  "kv_cache": true,
  "sampling": { "temperature": 0.0, "top_p": 0.95 }
}
```

nate: note — in local reproducer I accidentally had temperature 0.9 (human mistake when copy-pasting). But even with temp=0.0 the verbosity issue persisted. So likely model/kernel-level.

simon: quick log from canary instance (truncated):
```
[2026-03-15T10:21:02Z] infer: req=ab12 status=200 lat_ms=312 tokens=182
[2026-03-15T10:21:15Z] infer: req=ab13 status=200 lat_ms=1205 tokens=174
[2026-03-15T10:21:18Z] kv_cache: miss_count=0 rewind_calls=4
[2026-03-15T10:21:18Z] kernel: fused_attn_v2 selected
```

simon: that 1205ms spike correlates with longer outputs, not just queuing. Rewind_calls=4 looks suspicious.

carol: mb-271305 results: kv_cache=false -> p95 latency down ~30%, avg_tokens down ~35%, hallucination metric improved slightly. Fused_attn_v1 shows similar pattern. Attaching condensed CSV to the ticket.

maya: good catch. Action plan:
- rollback canary to q3_8-compatible variant for raptor-20b (owner @carol)
- disable kv_cache on q4_0 canary until we confirm KV consistent hashing (owner @simon)
- schedule deep dive on KV handling in quantized path (owner @simon + eng-runtime)
- run full eval suite on q4_0 with kv_cache=false and compare to baseline (owner @maya)

deploy-bot: Rollback queued: canary 'raptor-canary-3' -> target variant 'q3_8_raptor' initiated by carol

nate: quick suggestion — add a smoke test that asserts tokens_per_response median stays within 2x of baseline for very short prompts. Prevents silent verbosity regressions.

simon: @carol can you paste the canary model card metadata? want to confirm kv storage layout and pointer offsets for q4_0.

carol: pasted below:
```
model: raptor-20b
quant: q4_0
kv_layout: interleaved
kv_dtype: int8_packed
note: experimental pointer-compression
```

maya: thanks. I opened ticket INF-4932 and linked mb-271305 + csv. Putting this thread as the canonical triage for the moment.

nate: assigning follow-ups: INF-4932 owners -> simon (root cause), carol (rollback + benchmark), maya (eval + ticket), nate (smoke test PR). ETA for first patch (disable kv cache) 2 hours.

maya: if anyone hits a deterministic repro, drop it here. Prefer minimal prompt + model config. We'll reconvene after the deep dive. :white_check_mark:
